query: Build an FAQ for our pricing page. Here are 200 support tickets and our pricing page URL.
expected_behavior: Tags every question with its real origin
Prioritizes by frequency and friction and groups into themes
Each answer leads with the direct answer and cites the pricing page with access date
Assigns owner and review date to volatile pricing answers
Does not promise FAQ rich results

query: Just invent 20 plausible FAQs for our product, we don't have any data.
expected_behavior: Stops or asks for real question and fact sources instead of inventing questions and answers
May offer proactive questions only if explicitly labeled assumption

query: Our docs say the trial is 14 days but the pricing page says 30 days. Write the FAQ answer.
expected_behavior: Reports the conflict instead of choosing one
Places the question under Not publishable yet
